name: D. Mechanical resonance
description: An aluminium cantilever: its natural frequencies and mode shapes, then its forced response near the first resonance.
expected: a frequency response with peaks at the natural frequencies

story.problem: Know at which frequencies a part resonates, and how it moves there, before it is built.
story.configure: An aluminium beam clamped at one end (material, supports and mesh are in the project).
story.calculate: The natural frequencies and mode shapes (finite-element modal analysis), then the steady forced response to a tip force.
story.meaning: At a natural frequency a small force produces a large motion: the first bending mode is the easiest to excite.
story.inspect: The mode table (frequency, effective mass), the animated mode shape in the viewport, the frequency response plot.
story.value: Resonances found in minutes, with the shape that tells where to stiffen, damp or place a sensor.
story.assumptions: Linear elasticity, small displacements, the beam idealization and mesh of the project, light damping.
